analyzed: yaṃtra adhas paṭṭikāyām tat spṛśati aṅkam atha ālikhet 3 taṃtra sūkṣmam bhavet yantram tena nimna ādi nīyatām sūtrī id lamba gatiḥ yatra tat nimnam ca anyat unnatam paṭṭikā antena lambasya saṃyoge sama bhū talam adhiṣṭhānasya ca adhastāt upapīṭham prayojayet rakṣā artham unnata artham ca śobhā artham ca pracakṣate

analyzed: upapīṭha bahis bhāgam apadāṅgaṇam īritam tat aiśānyām prakartavyaḥ vāri mārgaḥ udak mukhaḥ aṅgaṇena mukhāyām ahīnena aṣṭa kṛteḥ padam kṛtvā tyaktā saumye procyām padam tyajet prakartavyam mahikā kuṭṭimam budhaiḥ upa pīṭha ādi saṃyuktam turyaśram dhvaja yonikam vistāra samaḥ utsedhaḥ pāda ūnam vā yathocitam

original: gṛhādyaṅgānurūpeṇa kartavyaṃ mañcakādibhiḥ || 13 || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi racanāṃ sarvaveśmanām | gṛhāṇāṃ karaṇe śaste muhūrte sthapatiḥ svayam || 14 || vāstuvidhāyāṃ snāto'tha vāsasī lakṣṇe navīne paridhāya ca | uttarīyādibhiḥ sarvairanulepairalaṅkṛtaḥ || 15 || saṃpūjyātha gaṇādhīśaṃ viprebhyo dīyatāṃ vasu |
analyzed: gṛha ādi aṅga anurūpeṇa kartavyam mañcaka ādibhiḥ atha atas saṃpravakṣyāmi racanām sarva veśmanām gṛhāṇām karaṇe śaste muhūrte sthapatiḥ svayam vāstu vidhāyām snātaḥ utha vāsasī lakṣṇe navīne paridhāya ca uttarīya ādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ anulepaiḥ alaṅkṛtaḥ saṃpūjya atha gaṇādhīśam viprebhyaḥ dīyatām vasu

analyzed: ādi aṅga artham tu tat dravyam āśīrvādaiḥ dvija īritaiḥ sahitaḥ prāmukhaḥ sthitvā vinyaset tatra pādukam janma ādyam apidhāna antam buddhyā niścitya mandiram patra mānam iti proktam uttaram janma niṣkramam samantāt paritas kuryāt diś vaiidiva aṅgula aṣṭakam prāyeṇa nṝṇām bhavane patra mānam udāhṛtam

original: anyatra kṛpādibhyo'tha bahiyoniḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 19 || upānaṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā vinyaset tatra pādukam | dvārasya dakṣiṇe stambhe garbhanyāso vidhīyate || 20 || pādukopari viprasya nṛpāṇāṃ tadadhaḥ smṛtam | viśāṃ tu tadvastātra tadadhaḥ śūdrajanmanām || 21 || vinyasejjanmano mūrdhni jagatyādyaustu deśikaḥ |
analyzed: anyatra kṛpā ādibhyaḥ atha bahiyoniḥ prakīrtitaḥ 19 upānam paritas kṛtvā vinyaset tatra pādukam dvārasya dakṣiṇe stambhe garbhanyāsaḥ vidhīyate pādukā upari viprasya nṛpāṇām tad adhas smṛtam viśām tu tat vastā atra tad adhas śūdrajanmanām vinyaset janmanaḥ mūrdhni jagatyāt yauḥ tu deśikaḥ

original: evaṃ kṛtvā tadādyaṅgaṃ talipaṃ tatra vinyaset || 22 || dārusvīkaraṇaṃ paścānnidhigehasya lakṣaṇe | vakṣye naivātra vakṣyāmi granthabāhulyato bhayāt || 23 || dvāraṃ ca dikṣu kartavyaṃ sarveṣāmapi veśmanām | madhyasthadvāramadhyaṃ syād vāstumandirasūtrayoḥ || 24 || upārāṇi yujyanta pradakṣiṇyāt svayonitaḥ |
analyzed: evam kṛtvā tad ādi aṅgam tad lipam tatra vinyaset dāru svīkaraṇam paścāt nidhi gehasya lakṣaṇe vakṣye na eva atra vakṣyāmi grantha bāhulyataḥ bhayāt dvāram ca dikṣu kartavyam sarveṣām api veśmanām madhyastha dvāra madhyam syāt vāstu mandira sūtrayoḥ upārāṇi yujyanta pradakṣiṇyāt sva yonitaḥ

original: dvārapādasya vistāraṃ tulyamuttaratārataḥ || 25 || svasvayonyā gṛhādīnāṃ kartavyā dvārayonayaḥ | prastarottarayormadhyaṃ pañcadhā vibhajed budhaḥ || 26 || dvārāyāmaṃ caturbhāgaṃ śeṣāṃśe sūryabhājite | śironmānaṃ tu saptāśaṃ pañcāṃśaṃ gulphamiṣyate || 27 || utsedhaśeṣaṃ paridheratāramudāhṛtam | prastarottarayormadhyamaṣṭabhāgaivibhājite || 28 ||
analyzed: dvāra pādasya vistāram tulyam uttara tārataḥ 25 sva sva yonyā gṛha ādīnām kartavyāḥ dvārayonayaḥ prastara uttarayoḥ madhyam pañcadhā vibhajet budhaḥ dvāra āyāmam catur bhāgam śeṣa aṃśe sūrya bhājite śira unmānam tu saptāśam pañca aṃśam gulpham iṣyate 27 utsedha śeṣam paridheḥ atāram udāhṛtam prastara uttarayoḥ madhyam aṣṭa bhāgaiḥ vibhājite

original: saptāṃśamāyataṃ kuryānnavapaścāṃśavistaram | utsedhaśeṣaṃ navabhirhatvā pañcāṃśakaṃ śiraḥ || 29 || gulphamānaṃ caturbhāgaṃ kuryācchāstraviśāradaḥ | athavā guṇatāraṃ vā kuryād dvāraṃ yathocitam || 30 || āgneyyāṃ mandiraṃ dvāraṃ dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ smṛtam | pratyaṅmukhaṃ tu nairṛtyāṃ vāyavyāṃ tadudamukham || 31 ||
analyzed: sapta aṃśam āyatam kuryāt nava paśca aṃśa vistaram utsedha śeṣam navabhiḥ hatvā pañca aṃśakam śiraḥ gulpha mānam catur bhāgam kuryāt śāstra viśāradaḥ athavā guṇa tāram vā kuryāt dvāram yathocitam 30 āgneyyām mandiram dvāram dakṣiṇa abhimukham smṛtam pratyak mukham tu nairṛtyām vāyavyām tat uda mukham

original: īśe tat prāṅmukhaṃ kuryāt tāni syuḥ pādukopari || 313 || iti vāstuvidyāyāṃ dvāravinyāso nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | kavāṭadvitayaṃ kuryānmātṛputryabhidhaṃ budhaḥ | dvāratāre catuṣpañcaṣaṭsaptāṣṭavibhājite || 1 || ekāṃśaḥ sūtrapaṭṭiḥ syāt samaṃ vā bahalaṃ bhavet | ardhe vā pādahīnaṃ vā bahalaṃ parikīrtitam || 2||
analyzed: īśe tat prāc mukham kuryāt tāni syuḥ pādukā upari iti vāstuvidyāyām dvāravinyāsaḥ nāma trayodaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ kavāṭa dvitayam kuryāt mātṛputrī abhidham budhaḥ dvāra tāre catuṣpañca ṣaṣ sapta aṣṭa vibhājite eka aṃśaḥ sūtra paṭṭiḥ syāt samam vā bahalam bhavet ardhe vā pāda hīnam vā bahalam parikīrtitam 2

original: dvārāyāmasamāyāmā kāryā yugmāśca paṅkhyaḥ | aśvyādiveśmapairyantāḥ payaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 3 || agnyādyatyaṣṭisaṃkhyāntānyambujānyagrasandhiṣu | tārārdhamucchrayaṃ teṣāṃ tribhāgaikaṃ tu vā bhavet || 4 || bahalārdhaṃ tu vā kuryāducchraye darśanāṃśite | ithaṃśaṃ tadūrdhvapaṭṭaṃ syādantari tribhiraṃśakaiḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: kāryāḥ yugmāḥ ca paṅkhyaḥ payaḥ parikīrtitāḥ 3 agni ādi atyaṣṭi saṃkhyā antāni ambujāni agra sandhiṣu tārārdham ucchrayam teṣām tri bhāga ekam tu vā bhavet bahala ardham tu vā kuryāt ucchraye darśana aṃśite tad ūrdhva paṭṭam syāt antari tribhiḥ aṃśakaiḥ

original: dalāṣṭakayutaṃ cāpi vṛttaṃ kesarasaṃyutam | adhaḥpaṭṭaṃ tadekāṃśaṃ turyaśraṃ tatsamocchrayam || 6 || mūlāgraipaṅkaje kārye hyardhavṛddhavicitrite | pacayaśca niraśrāśca muktādāmavicitritāḥ || 7 || paṭṭikācaturaṃśaikayutadvārārdhavistṛtam | svabāhalyena sahitaṃ kavāṭasya samīhate || 8 || paṭṭikārdhena rahitaitāvaḍyāsā ca putrikā |
analyzed: dala aṣṭaka yutam ca api vṛttam kesara saṃyutam adhas paṭṭam tad eka aṃśam turyaśram tad sama ucchrayam mūla agrai paṅkaje kārye hi ardha vṛddha vicitrite pacayaḥ ca niraśrāḥ ca muktā dāma vicitritāḥ paṭṭikā catur aṃśa eka yuta dvāra ardha vistṛtam sva bāhalyena sahitam kavāṭasya samīhate paṭṭikā ardhena rahitā etāvat ḍyāsā ca putrikā

original: vasvādisaṃkṛtyantāsu saṃkhyāstrekaikameva tat || 9 || kavāṭasya tu bāhalyaṃ dvāravistāramānataḥ | raṅgapādau ca kartavyau suvṛttāvagramūlayoḥ || 10 || strabāhalyasamāyāmaṃ sārdhaṃ vā mūlapādukam | bhārabāhalyasadṛśamagrapādāyataṃ bhavet || 11 || sārdhaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ vā syād yathāśobhaṃ yathādṛḍham | kavāṭayostārasamaṃ bhārāyāmamudīritam || 12 ||
analyzed: vasu ādi saṃkṛti antāsu saṃkhyāḥ trekaikam eva tat kavāṭasya tu bāhalyam dvāra vistāra mānataḥ raṅga pādau ca kartavyau su vṛttau agra mūlayoḥ stra bāhalya samāyāmam sārdham vā mūlapādukam bhāra bāhalya sadṛśam agra pāda āyatam bhavet sārdham vā dviguṇam vā syāt yathāśobham yathādṛḍham kavāṭayoḥ tāra samam bhāra āyāmam udīritam 12

original: vistārasadṛśāyāmau pucchau bhārasya kīrtitau | bhāratāraṃ prakartavyaṃ dvāraṃ prati samādibhiḥ || 13 || samaṃ vā pādahīnaṃ vāpyardhe vā bahalaṃ bhavet | bhāratāre'bdhisaṃbhakte trīṇi sūtrāṇi pātayet || 14 || tiryak sūtratrayaṃ kārya dvāramadhyāprayorapi | ādyasūtrayutinyastapādakarkibhrameṇa tu || 15 ||
analyzed: vistāra sadṛśa āyāmau pucchau bhārasya kīrtitau bhāra tāram prakartavyam dvāram prati sama ādibhiḥ samam vā pāda hīnam vā api ardhe vā bahalam bhavet bhāra tāra ibdhi saṃbhakte trīṇi sūtrāṇi pātayet tiryak sūtra trayam dvāra madhya aprayoḥ api ādya sūtra yuti nyasta pāda karki bhrameṇa tu

original: khaṇḍivṛttaṃ prakartavyaṃ tṛtīyāt sūtrato bahiḥ | evaṃ khaṇḍitrayaṃ kārya nimnamūlāgramadhyame || 16 || nimnakhaṇḍiyutiryatra tatra tatra vicitritam | parvamadhyagataṃ hyaśraṃ parityājyaṃ ca śilpibhiḥ || 17 || kārye ca suṣire vṛtte bahistiryaksthasūtrayoḥ | ādyasūtrebahirbhāge tvante cādyaṃ padaṃ bhavet || 18 ||

original: v āstuvidyāyāṃ yujyatāṃ dvārapādābhyāṃ praterurdhve 'rdhapāṇinā | śulakīlādivedhaiścai karotu dṛḍhatāṃ punaḥ || 19 || evaṃ kuryādadhobhāraṃ madhyakhaṇḍivivarjitam | padamādyaṃ parityājyaṃ dvitīye cāvaṭadvayam || 20 || raṅgapādapramāṇena vartulaṃ cārdhanimnakam | paṭṭikācaturaṃśaikabhāgaṃ nītvātha pārśvataḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: āstu vidyāyām yujyatām dvāra pādābhyām śula kīla ādi vedhaiḥ karotu dṛḍha tām punar evam kuryāt adhobhāram madhya khaṇḍi vivarjitam padam ādyam parityājyam dvitīye ca āvaṭa dvayam raṅga pāda pramāṇena vartulam ca ardha nimnakam paṭṭikā catur aṃśa eka bhāgam nītvā atha pārśvatas 21

original: mātṛsaṃjñakavāṭasya sūtramantarnipātayet | pratibāhalyasadṛśaṃ nītvā mūlāgrayoḥ pṛthak || 22 || ardha vā pādahīnaṃ vā mūle tanmadhyasūtrake | ūrdhvāgrameva tanmadhye vinyaset sūtrapaṭṭikām || 23 || sarojakorakākāraiḥ kīlairvā puṣpasannibhaiḥ | paṭṭikāṃ padmamadhyeṣu viddhaiḥ kuryācca niścalām || 24 || dvārīyāmaśarāṃśaikamaramāyāmamīritam |
analyzed: mātṛ saṃjñaka vāṭasya sūtram antar nipātayet pratibāhalya sadṛśam nītvā mūla agrayoḥ pṛthak vā pāda hīnam vā mūle tad madhya sūtrake ūrdhva agram eva tad madhye vinyaset sūtra paṭṭikām saroja koraka ākāraiḥ kīlaiḥ vā puṣpa sannibhaiḥ paṭṭikām padma madhyeṣu viddhaiḥ kuryāt ca niścalām dvārīyāma śara aṃśa ekam arama āyāmam īritam

original: yugavahnayekabhāgaṃ vā ṣaṭpañcaikāṃśavistaram || 25 || vyāsapādonama vā samaṃ vā bahalaṃ viduḥ | adhobhārasamākārā kīrtitā śilpavittamaiḥ || 26 || tadāyāme'bdhisaṃbhakte tyajedekaikamagrayoḥ | madhye nidhāya dvitayaṃ tatsandhāvargalasya ca || 27 || kuryācca kabalīṃ tatra hyargalasya pramāṇataḥ | kavāṭavyāsasadṛśamargalasyāyataṃ viduḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: yuga vahnayā eka bhāgam vā ṣaṣ pañca eka aṃśa vistaram vā samam vā bahalam viduḥ adhobhāra sama ākārā kīrtitā śilpa vittamaiḥ tad āyāma ibdhi saṃbhakte tyajet ekaikam agrayoḥ madhye nidhāya dvitayam tad sandhau argalasya ca kuryāt ca kabalīm tatra hi argalasya pramāṇataḥ kavāṭa vyāsa sadṛśam argalasya āyatam viduḥ

original: pādonaṃ vā tadaṣṭāṃśādekaṃ tattārameva ca | tārā bahalaṃ kuryāt khaṇḍau bāhalyatulyakau || 29 || mūlakhaṇḍaḥ samākhyātaḥ svavyāsasadṛśāyataḥ | ardha vā pādahīnaṃ vāpyagrakhaṇḍyāyataṃ bhavet || 30 || aramābahalāyāmaṃ tatpucchaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ | ekaṃ vā syādupaḍārakavāṭamiti kecana || 31 || dvāratāraṃ kavāṭasya bahaladvayasaṃyutam |
analyzed: pāda ūnam vā tad aṣṭa aṃśāt ekam tat tāram eva ca tārā bahalam kuryāt khaṇḍau bāhalya tulyakau mūlakhaṇḍaḥ samākhyātaḥ sva vyāsa sadṛśa āyataḥ vā pāda hīnam vā api agra khaṇḍya āyatam bhavet 30 tat puccham kathitam budhaiḥ ekam vā syāt upaḍāra kavāṭam iti kecana dvāra tāram kavāṭasya bahala dvaya saṃyutam

original: mūlāgrayorvāmabhāge raṅgavādadvayaṃ bhavet || 32 || āyataṃ bhāravahnayekama bhārasya kīrtitam | asya khaṇḍī bhavedekā mūlāgrau bhāravat smṛtau || 33 || gartaśaṅkuca kartavyo vitastyāyata eva saḥ | kavāṭabahalaḍimabahalavyāsava ca || 34 || vibhajedūrdhvadeśena dvidhā caikatare pade | padāyatavyāsamadhyanyastakarkibhrameṇa ca || 35 ||
analyzed: mūla agrayoḥ vāma bhāge raṅga vāda dvayam bhavet āyatam bhāra vahnayā ekam bhārasya kīrtitam asya khaṇḍī bhavet ekā mūla agrau bhāra vat smṛtau garta śaṅkuḥ ca kartavyaḥ vitasti āyataḥ eva saḥ ca vibhajet ūrdhva deśena dvidhā ca ekatare pade pada āyata vyāsa madhya nyasta karki bhrameṇa ca
